summary: Comprehensive testing of CAPEX Portal redesigned Login Page (split-screen with bearing animation), Admin Dashboard (dark industrial theme), Sidebar navigation (no Samples option), and New Sample from Request Detail. All 15 backend tests pass. All frontend features working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features tested and working. Login page has split-screen layout: left panel shows rotating bearing animation with inspection lamp and starfield, right panel shows login form with demo credential buttons. Admin login redirects to /admin, other roles to /dashboard. Admin Dashboard has dark industrial theme with 5 tabs (Overview, Plants, Departments, Users, Resets). Sidebar shows Dashboard, CAPEX Requests, Analytics, Users - NO Samples option. New Sample button appears in Request Detail right sidebar for Buyer/Capex Head roles.
